::: {#perfil}

Deep learning researcher at the GAIA Lab. PhD student at FGV EMAp, where she also earned an MSc in Mathematical Modeling and Data Science and a BSc in Data Science and AI. She previously worked in quantitative credit research at SPX Capital.

## Education

- PhD — FGV EMAp (in progress)
- MSc in Mathematical Modeling and Data Science — FGV EMAp, 2024–2025
- BSc in Data Science and AI — FGV EMAp, 2020–2023

## Interests

Machine learning, deep learning, and statistical modeling.
